title: 36(b)(1) Arms Sales Notification
summary: The Defense Security Cooperation Agency published Federal Register notice 2011-18399 (Transmittal No. 11-28) containing the unclassified text of a Section 36(b)(1) arms sales notification, dated July 14, 2011, and published July 21, 2011. The notice text provided consists only of the cover page and the Federal Register header; the transmittal letter, purchasing country, item details, values, and policy justification are contained in graphic images that are not included in the text provided, so these details could not be extracted.

DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE

Office of the Secretary

[Transmittal Nos. 11-28]


36(b)(1) Arms Sales Notification

AGENCY: Department of Defense, Defense Security Cooperation Agency.

ACTION: Notice.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The Department of Defense is publishing the unclassified text 
of a section 36(b)(1) arms sales notification. This is published to 
fulfill the requirements of section 155 of Public Law 104-164 dated 
July 21, 1996.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Ms. B. English, DSCA/DBO/CFM, (703) 
601-3740.
    The following is a copy of a letter to the Speaker of the House of 
Representatives, Transmittals 11-28 with attached transmittal, and 
policy justification.

    Dated: July 14, 2011.
Aaron Siegel,
Alternate OSD Federal Register Liaison Officer, Department of Defense.
